description: neuralese-direct-v2 (the unified base: full-prompt warm-up 0.5 epoch then program-header direct_sft 2 epochs, context capacity 32768, shared 48-probe monitor) on base LFM2.5-350M (LiquidAI/LFM2.5-350M, revision 9e6c6ccf; heads from the base model). Every difference is declared in training/neuralese/line-parity.json (plans/neuralese/LINE_PARITY.md). Fit-only: target_tokens 256 (8 GB GPU); batch_tokens 16384 (Pop measures and may change it; on the current data 884 + 782 packed updates); cadence from the derived update counts (Pop resets it from measured seconds to keep evaluation near 3% of wall time). Equal supervision is equal epochs over the same documents (the base's 0.5 + 2). Backbone-inherent, evidence-backed: backbone lr 7.5e-7 (LFM V6 at the shared 7.5e-6 drift-stopped at update 260, gate 16/48 against base 26/48; V8 at 7.5e-7 finished 1000 updates, gate 22/48, response KL 0.018); the measured base gate_pass 26/48. Declared gap: no quantization component yet (the owner's QAT rule applies once an LFM component is declared). History: recipes/HISTORY.md.

reference.source: untrained base LFM2.5-350M on the 48 probes, 26/48 (registry luna-direct-untrained-base-behavior-gate-held-20261011-v2, runs/luna-neuralese-direct-base-behavior-20261011-v2/report.json)
